# Store accepts secret-bearing event bodies; leak blocked all tickets pushes

## Summary

At 2026-08-03 19:13 an agent session posted a comment on ticket 129e containing a full zsh environment dump. The dump embedded SEVEN live credentials (Anthropic, 2x GitHub PAT, Gemini/Google, Jira/Atlassian, OpenAI service-account, PyPI). GitHub push protection then rejected refs/heads/tickets (GH013) on the Anthropic key, so EVERY session's store writes queued local-only (153 commits at diagnosis) — a full store-sharing outage triggered by one comment.

rebar has no write-time secret guard: `comment`/`edit`/event append accept arbitrary bodies, and the auto-push seam surfaces the rejection only as `WARNING rebar._store.push: tickets branch push failed after 3 retries`, which names neither the offending commit nor the reason, so the outage looks like transient contention.

## Root cause

1. No secret-pattern screening at the event-write seam (comment/description/session-log bodies).
2. The push-retry path swallows the git error detail (GH013 + secret location were only visible via a manual `git push`).

## Fix plan

1. Add a deterministic secret screen at the event-append seam (single choke point all writers share): reject or redact bodies matching high-confidence credential patterns (sk-ant-*, ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_, github_pat_, AIza…, ATATT…, xox?-, AKIA…, pypi-AgE…, sk-proj-/sk-svcacct-, PEM private-key headers) BEFORE the event file is written. Reject with a teaching message (what matched, why, how to redact); `--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>` style override deliberately NOT provided over MCP.
2. Surface push-rejection detail: when the store push fails, include the git stderr tail (first GH013 violation line + path) in the warning so the failure self-identifies.
3. Unit tests: each pattern fires; placeholder/regex-text forms (e.g. `sk-ant-api03-...`, `sk-ant-api03-[A-Za-z0-9_-]`) do NOT fire (word-boundary + length guards — the store already contains such benign strings in jira-reb-687 REVIEW_RESULT events); redaction path preserves event schema; push-failure warning carries the reason.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Event-append rejects (or redacts, per config) bodies matching the high-confidence credential patterns, with a teaching message naming the matched pattern class.
- [ ] Placeholder/truncated forms and pattern-literals in review payloads do not trip the screen (regression fixtures from jira-reb-687 events).
- [ ] Store push failures log the git rejection reason (GH013 line + offending path) instead of a bare retry count.
- [ ] Unit tests cover fire/no-fire per pattern and the enriched push warning.
- [ ] The refusal names the matched secret family and does NOT echo the secret value itself.
- [ ] Benign look-alike text is not refused, evidenced by explicit negative cases, so the screen is safe to leave on by default.
- [ ] The safe way to pass untrusted or quoted text as a comment body is documented where agents will read it (the shell command-substitution / backtick hazard that produced this incident).
- [ ] The incident is recorded with its blast radius, including that the only control which actually stopped the leak was GitHub push protection, i.e. outside this project.

## File impact

- src/rebar (event-append seam; store push module) — exact modules to be pinned during planning with Serena/grep.
- tests/unit (new secret-screen suite; push-warning test).

## Absorbed from e4f4 (closed as duplicate)

e4f4-295b-2c03-44c4 described the same underlying defect (the store accepting
secret-bearing event bodies) and was filed about 8 minutes apart from this ticket with no
link between them. Its two ACs with no counterpart here -- documenting the shell
command-substitution hazard for agents, and recording the incident with its blast radius --
are folded into the Acceptance Criteria above so nothing is lost by closing it.
